meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会按 BIDS 标准帮你组织脑影像与电生理数据：建目录与文件名、写 JSON 元数据 sidecar、用 PyBIDS 查询已有数据集、调用 bids-validator 校验,并把 DICOM 转成 BIDS。
howto.when: 当你处理 BIDS 数据集时触发,比如整理影像或电生理数据、查询已有数据集、校验合规性等。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you organize neuroscience data into BIDS: building folder structures and filenames, writing JSON sidecars, querying datasets with PyBIDS, validating with bids-validator, and converting DICOM to BIDS.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with BIDS datasets, e.g. organizing imaging or electrophysiology data, querying an existing dataset, or checking compliance.
